CHAIN: "Complement system" -> "promotes chemotaxis" -> "enhances immune response" -> "does not involve glycolysis" -> 90%

analysis: The complement system is a part of the immune system that enhances the ability of antibodies and phagocytic cells to clear pathogens. Its functions include lysis of pathogens (opa), chemotaxis (opb), and opsonization (opd). However, glycolysis (opc) is a metabolic pathway for breaking down glucose and is not a function of the complement system.
